visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) At the entrance of an indoor exhibition, a man wearing a brown beanie and a black traditional-style jacket holds a colorful promotional packet featuring anime characters. He stands before a rainbow-arched entrance illuminated by neon tubes, with a sign reading "25th OJAMJO". The background is filled with vibrant character cutouts and musical note decorations under bright studio lighting. (2) The man performs a close-up reveal of a commemorative exhibition ticket, pulling it from a white envelope. The ticket is gold-flecked with a holographic finish, depicting the main cast of characters in colorful witch outfits. His hands move precisely as he showcases the physical details of the ticket, while the background remains a blur of pastel exhibition colors. (3) Transitioning deeper into the venue, the man interacts with a massive green inflatable character called Majo Rika, posing beside it and leaning against its soft surface. The room features pink and purple walls decorated with character sketches, technical drawings, and large panels. Various exhibition-goers are visible in the background, walking between displays and taking photos under soft, ambient indoor lighting. (4) The scene shifts to a dedicated stage area painted in bright pink, where a life-size statue of a pink-haired witch character stands. The man poses on the platform, holding a glowing pink magic wand prop and mimicking a magical girl pose. He then takes a mirror selfie in a heart-shaped frame, capturing himself surrounded by character decals as the video concludes with a wide view of the celebratory displays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy, fast-tempo Japanese J-pop track featuring a bright, enthusiastic male vocal performance covering the 'Ojamajo Carnival!!' theme. The music has a strong 4/4 electronic beat with vibrant synthesizer brass layers. (2) A sharp mechanical 'click' and 'thud' sound occurs as a handheld stamp is pressed firmly onto paper. The music continues without interruption, maintaining its high-arousal energy. (3) The pop song enters its chorus section with increased vocal intensity and rhythmic drive. The acoustic texture is bright and polished, typical of studio-produced anime covers. (4) A second mechanical stamping sound is heard, punctuating the music's bridge. The background environment has a faint, low-level indoor resonance from the exhibition hall. (5) The track reaches its final chorus with a dense mix of synths and drums before a sharp cut at the end of the video timeline.
